Specification: This module is a TLC model-checking companion module for a single-lane bridge specification. It does not define the bridge algorithm itself; instead, it extends the existing SingleLaneBridge specification and introduces concrete constant definitions used to instantiate the model for checking. The file provides finite sets of right-moving cars, left-moving cars, bridge positions, and positions, and contains no additional actions, temporal properties, or proofs of its own.
